indicators.name: archived_in_software_heritage
checks: Searches for Zenodo and Software Heritage badges in the README file of the repository

indicators.name: descriptive_metadata
checks: Searches for description, programming languages, date of creation and keywords in the repository

indicators.name: has_releases
checks: Searches for release tags in the repository

indicators.name: persistent_and_unique_identifier
checks: Searches for an identifier in the README or CITATION.cff files of the repository

indicators.name: repository_workflows
checks: Searches for workflows in the repository

indicators.name: requirements_specified
checks: Searches for dependencies in project configuration files, README and dependencies files such as requirements.txt

indicators.name: software_has_citation
checks: Searches for an article citation or a reference publication in the codemeta and citation files

indicators.name: software_has_documentation
checks: Searches for a README file in the root repository and other forms of documentation such as a Read The Docs badge or url

indicators.name: software_has_license
checks: Searches for a file named 'LICENSE' or 'LICENSE.md' in the root of the repository.
Searches for licensing information in the codemeta, CITATION.cff and package files if they exist

indicators.name: version_control_use
checks: Checks if the URL provided is indeed a Github or Gitlab repository
